A '''gorgy-bird''' was a creature after which the [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] tactic, [[Wobbly as a mother Gorgybird]], was named. [[Gender/Legends|Female]] gorgy birds wobbled in flight after giving birth. However, this wobbling was only a ruse to lure predators away from the nest.
